models.title: AI models
models.lead: The brains (AI models) of this computer. Choose which one answers, which one starts with the computer, and download or remove them.
models.noneInUse: No brain is in use. Chat will not answer until you press Use this brain on one of them.
models.noDefault: No brain is set to start with the computer. Press Make default on one of them.
models.listFailed: The list of models could not be read.
models.empty: No AI model is known on this computer.
models.more: More models (not planned for this computer): {n}
models.state.failed: On this computer. It could not start last time.
models.why.serviceDown: The AI service is not running. Open Health and run a full check.
models.why.notChecked: Its files are not checked yet. Open Offline content and check the content.
models.why.cannotStart: This computer cannot start it now
models.why.busy: Wait for the current task to finish
models.why.unloadFirst: It is in use. Press Unload first.
models.why.downloadRunning: Wait for the current download to finish
models.confirmUse.title: Use {name}?
models.confirmUse.line1: The brain in use now stops, and questions in progress stop too.
models.confirmUse.line2: Starting a brain takes about a minute.
models.confirmUnload.title: Unload {name}?
models.confirmUnload.line1: Chat, Photo and Talk will not answer until a brain is in use again.
models.confirmDownload.title: Download {name}?
models.confirmDownload.line1: It needs {size} of disk space and the internet.
models.confirmDownload.line2: It can take a long time. You can keep using the computer while it downloads.
models.confirmDelete.title: Delete {name}?
models.confirmDelete.line1: This removes the model from this computer. You can download it again later with the internet, or copy it from the AI-ARK drive.
models.confirmLast.title: This is the last copy
models.confirmLast.line1: There is no other checked copy of {name} on this computer or on a connected AI-ARK drive.
models.confirmLast.line2: If you delete it, you can only get it back with the internet.
models.working.use: Starting {name} … this takes about a minute.
models.done.default: {name} will start each time the computer starts.
models.loadFailed: {name} could not start. The previous brain was started again.
models.loadFailedFix: Choose a smaller brain, or open Health and run a full check.
models.downloadFailed: The download of {name} did not finish.
models.downloadFailedFix: Check the internet and press Download again. Offline content shows more.
models.notOnDisk: {name} is not on this computer's own disk (only on a drive). Nothing was removed.
